verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents a step-by-step walkthrough for setting up SAML-based SSO with a custom app that is not in the pre-integrated catalog, letting users sign in with their managed Google account credentials (docs-25, docs-18). That covers the custom-SAML part of the story, but the pack says nothing about OIDC or header-based apps. Missing for 10: custom OIDC app configuration, header-based app SSO, documented walkthroughs for those app types, independent or hands-on corroboration of the custom SAML flow.
